data.access_approval: none-required: compiled-in registered inventory, no download
data.uncertainty: stefan-boltzmann constant determination; planck T4 ratio is computed independent of the sigma value

evaluation.comparison: both theories evaluated against the same sigma dataset; wien peak and uv-finiteness are out-of-calibration predictions (no dataset input)
evaluation.tolerance_justification: comparison is verdict-level against fixed datasets

objective.domain: cavity temperature 4000-6000 K; uv cutoff fixed
objective.inconclusive: sigma dataset cannot discriminate planck from rayleigh-jeans
objective.question: does planck hold the thermal obligations with calibration separated from evaluation while rayleigh-jeans is retained as the failed classical alternative
objective.success: planck holds all three; rayleigh-jeans fails stefan-boltzmann and uv-finite with the catastrophe explained
